items.caption: This seal-script-style form writes 箇 with 竹 above 固, matching the transmitted Shuowen analysis of the graph as bamboo plus phonetic 固. Duan Yucai’s commentary reports 个 as an alternate form meaning half a bamboo.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style 箇 form: a bamboo-like top component above a rounded lower enclosure containing an interior stroke.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the historically transmitted analysis of the related full form 箇 and the reported alternate-form account relevant to 个. It does not establish a dated graphic path to the modern simplified form.

limitations.text: The image is a modern vector redraw in a historical script style, not an artifact. The reported link between 箇 and 个 is an inherited lexicographic account, not an independently documented graphic sequence.
